summary: This video breaks down top-performing team compositions and skill timings for the Ice Guardian boss in Crown Contest. Skratch demonstrates performance across Ice Blast, Aura, Dauntless, and Toxin teams. Dauntless and Toxin setups yielded the highest damage output, exceeding 2.8B and 3.3B damage respectively. Key mechanic advice emphasizes avoiding summoner teams like Necrosis, as unit deaths grant the boss permanent stackable Attack and Defense buffs.

teams.note: Ice Blast setup achieving ~1.3B damage; Oggok can substitute for Anselmo.
Aura team reaching ~1.08B damage; Solmo can replace Rena if needed.
Top-tier Toxin team achieving over 3.35B damage per fight.

meta_changes: Summon-heavy compositions are soft-banned against Ice Guardian because dying summoned units permanently stack Attack and Defense buffs onto the boss.
tips: Never bring summon units to Ice Guardian fight to prevent feeding the boss stackable buffs.
If using Oggok instead of Anselmo in Ice Blast, set Oggok's skill timing to 17-19 seconds for optimal cleanses and shields.
Angelic Alliance artifact on Twitch yields peak Toxin team damage, but Iluya's Fang remains a strong secondary choice.
